manualSteps: REQUIRED FOR PASS: cold-restart only the isolated D6 backend after the accepted trip is saved. Keep the same isolated database schema, D6 usage ledger, local-test identity key, built H5, and run directory; resume that run directory, then use the visible UI to reopen the saved trip, switch to English and back to Chinese, and capture both details views. Preserve restart logs and the existing attempt history; do not replay the user turn. Any failure or unavailable control remains a recorded failure, not a skipped PASS step.

manualSteps: REQUIRED FOR PASS: if and only if a real displayed offer is available, adopt it through the visible flight detail control, continue planning from the adopted workspace, and preserve the observed flight identity/revision. Open the accepted trip from both the planner result and the visible My Trips entry, switch locale in trip details, and inspect recovery. Then cold-restart only the isolated D6 backend using the same isolated database schema, D6 usage ledger, local-test identity key, built H5, and run directory; resume that directory and repeat the visible My Trips/detail recovery check. Preserve restart logs and attempts. If search/adoption/accepted delivery is unavailable, record the failure; never substitute a synthetic itinerary or flight, and do not report PASS with these steps incomplete.
